December 2009 # **21****st** **December-31****st** **December 2009** # **TC/RCs annual negotiations still continue** Major Japanese smelters have accepted a 38% reduction (compared to the 2009 annual terms of $75/7.5¢/lb) in 2010 processing fees with Freeport McMoRan, setting a benchmark for the TC/RCs annual negotiations. TC/RCs were settled at $46.5/4.65¢/lb. Meanwhile, Yangjun, the general manager of Tongling’s international trade department and a major member of the CSPT has said that he would like to accept terms at this level. We have also recently heard reports that both Jiangxi and Tongling have agreed terms at this level ($46.5/4.65¢/lb) with Freeport. Meanwhile, market insiders have said that BHP Billiton, the world’s largest mining company, is still striving to achieve lower TC/RCs. During the second round of negotiations BHP Billiton was understood to be offering terms at the $43/4.3¢/lb level whilst Chinese miners were holding out for terms closer to the $60/6¢/lb level. We have heard that the third round of negotiations between BHP Billiton and the Japanese smelters may begin in mid January 2010, with discussions with Chinese smelters expected to follow. It is possible that TC/RCs may finally settle a little bit lower than the $46.5/4.65¢/lb agreed with Freeport McMoRan. We believe there is limited scope for TC/RCs to fall much below the terms agreed with Freeport. Smelter profits are being squeezed given the lower by- product acid prices. Furthermore, there is no certainty of a prolonged positive arbitrage between SHFE and LME as was the case earlier in 2009. © 2009 CRU International Limited **confidential** **December 2009** www.crumonitor.com # **Spot premium for imported cathode keeps rising** The spot premium for imported cathode has consistently risen since the beginning of December and is currently being quoted at around $80-90/t compared to $50-55/t at the beginning of December. In addition, the premium for imported SXEW cathode is now being quoted at $70-80/t. Recently, the SHFE/LME price ratio has risen and, as a result, import losses have narrowed and in some cases profits are being made. Moreover, traders may feel there is no need to sell cathode at a premium lower than $85/t, which is the annual premium benchmark. However market participants have told CRU that deals are being concluded at around $80/t, especially with LME copper prices above $7200/t. Consumers have been increasingly reluctant to accept higher premiums whilst the copper price has scaled higher. However, we do not believe that the spot premium has enough momentum to continue climbing in the short term as domestic supply continues to rise and consumption is expected to soften. # **Shanghai physical price weakens compared to SHFE** Alongside a surging LME copper price, the SHFE market has also moved up. However, the higher copper price may discourage consumers’ purchasing enthusiasm. Now that there is the possibility of some profit on sales of imported cathode, some traders have released imported material into the market. As a consequence, the Shanghai physical price has risen at a slower pace than the SHFE cash price. The smelter/refineries are currently negotiating their annual contracts with their consumers, but they are reluctant to sell cathodes when the Shanghai physical market is trading at a discount to SHFE, indicating some weakness in the physical market. # **Copper prices hit new record highs in 2009** Lately, LME and SHFE copper prices have soared. On Christmas Eve, the LME 3-month copper price had traded to a high of $7,160/t due to the weaker US dollar. The SHFE 3-month copper prices jumped to RMB58,260/t while the LME market was closed. This increase may also have been attributed to the © 2009 CRU Internatonal Ltd **confidential** Page 2 of 3 **December 2009** www.crumonitor.com decline in SHFE inventories. SHFE copper inventories fell by 8,015 tonnes to 96,362 tonnes on 25th December and by a further 1,047 tonnes to 95,315 tonnes on 31st December. ## **SHFE cash price hits new record highPrice differential between Shanghai spot market and SHFE cash month** Yuan/t

From a fundamental perspective there are both upside and downside factors which may influence the copper 50000 price in the short term. On the downside, most 40000 consumers do not anticipate any upturn in order activity ahead of the Spring Festival. In addition, domestic 30000 cathode output is being maintained at a high level. On 20000 the upside, a few large consumers, especially copper Dec-08 Mar-09 Jun-09 Sep-09 wirerod fabricators, are preparing to build up their stock Data: SHFE of cathodes ahead of the Spring Festival holiday as well as in anticipation of higher copper prices. Meanwhile, copper tube makers will increase their capacity utilisation as they enter into strong consumption season (usually November to next May). Given the combination of some positive market sentiment, favourable movements in the US dollar and increased investment activity, we would expect to see more upside movement in the copper price in the short term. As a consequence SHFE copper prices are expected to hover around RMB58,000-59,000/t. ### **Questions or comments may
